bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT r.room_id,r.status,r.revision,a.announcement_id,a.status,coalesce(d.status,'NO_DELIVERY'),coalesce(t.board_key,'NO_BOARD'),coalesce(t.message_thread_id,0),coalesce(d.telegram_message_id,0) FROM room_posts r LEFT JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.room_id=r.room_id LEFT JOIN posting_deliveries d ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text LEFT JOIN posting_topics t ON t.topic_id=d.posting_topic_id WHERE r.title='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト' AND r.created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY r.room_id,d.delivery_id"
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT e.kind,q.state,count(*) FROM room_source_events e JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=e.room_id LEFT JOIN room_status_message_edits q ON q.room_event_id=e.event_id WHERE r.title='【検証】ROOM公開同期テスト' AND r.created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY e.kind,q.state ORDER BY e.kind,q.state"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 72
echo ROOM_NEW_PUBLIC_DATABASE_READBACK=PASS
